title: Python \ Angular (AI agents)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack who codes daily, leverages Claude Code to accelerate development, leads the team, ensures quality, and builds automated tests for QA.
This is a Claude Code–first position: you will spend most of your time coding, conducting code reviews, collaborating with AI, tracking sprint progress, and leading the team by example.
What You’ll Build
- AI agents for leasing, maintenance, HR, accounting, and marketing.
- Real-time analytics dashboards for multi-property operations.
- End-to-end automation of property management workflows.
- Deep integrations with external services such as Yardi, Zillow, Apartments.com, and others.
Responsibilities
- Write fast, clean, and reliable code.
- Use Claude Code daily to generate structured and production-ready code.
- Review and approve pull requests (frontend + backend).
- Create and maintain automated test suites.
- Mentor developers and manage sprint progress.
- Ensure transparency and accountability at every stage of development.
Experience Requirements
- Django/Python — 4+ years of commercial experience, including Django REST Framework.
- Angular/TypeScript — 3+ years of experience developing complex Angular applications.
- Claude Code — daily usage in production workflows.
- AI Integrations — experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar APIs.
- API Integrations — strong understanding of REST APIs and webhooks.
- Databases — solid PostgreSQL knowledge (schema design and optimization).
